findings.title: iOS Finish pill/maybeAutoFinish re-enters during the deferred-win window and permanently discards the win
findings.failure_scenario: Auto-finish lands the last card -> finishing=false, onWin deferred 0.38s. In that window won=false, finishing=false, board complete, so canOfferFinish==true and the Finish pill renders. Player taps Finish (or toggles autoFinishMode) -> runAutoFinish() bumps finishGen -> pending onWin block's guard finishGen==gen fails, onWin never fires. won stays false, winStore.record never called, board not persisted: solved board, no overlay, win lost.
findings.rationale: autoFinishWouldWin() returns true on a complete board (greedy loop moves nothing; final allSatisfy == checkWin). iOS canOfferFinish/maybeAutoFinish/runAutoFinish gate on flag !won not the position; web is immune via !isWon() (index.html:789,779).
findings.suggested_fix: Gate iOS canOfferFinish/maybeAutoFinish/runAutoFinish on the actual position (&& !checkWin()/!boardComplete), or make autoFinishWouldWin() false on a complete board — matching web's !isWon().

status_history.validation: All three gates (runAutoFinish/maybeAutoFinish/canOfferFinish) include !checkWin(); audited all finishGen bump sites; pending onWin fires normally; web already immune. FIXED.

findings.title: Process kill / tab close inside the deferred-win window loses the win record (regression from synchronous onWin)
findings.failure_scenario: Last card lands; during the 0.38s/320ms delay the board is complete but win is not recorded and persist()/saveGame() refuse a complete board. If the app is killed (iOS) or tab closed (web) before the timer fires, onWin never runs: no winStore/wins[seed] entry, best time lost, next launch deals fresh. Pre-commit onWin fired synchronously so the win was durable.
findings.rationale: persist() guards !boardComplete (Game.swift:156), saveGame() guards !isWon() (index.html:403); the only record path is the deferred onWin timer, which a kill drops.
findings.suggested_fix: Record the win durably (winStore.record / wins[seed]) synchronously at the winning step; defer only the overlay presentation (won=true / DOM overlay).

status_history.validation: recordWin() split out, called synchronously at winning step, once-guarded (winRecorded/pendingWin); onWin's 2nd call no-ops; exactly-once verified; moveCount/clock correct; kill-during-beat keeps the win; flags reset on deal/restore. FIXED.

findings.title: No automated coverage for the win-record / deferred-overlay timing logic
findings.failure_scenario: A future refactor re-defers recordWin or drops a !checkWin() gate; tests stay green while a kill-during-beat again loses the win or the Finish pill re-offers over a solved board.
findings.rationale: 24 node tests cover engine rules/safe-autoplay/restore/autoFinishWouldWin only; nothing exercises recordWin/winRecorded once-guard, deferred onWin gating, or record-then-undo. Both fixes were timing bugs invisible to current CI.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a headless harness test: recordWin idempotent under double-call; simulated undo-during-beat leaves the win recorded once; the canOffer/maybe/run gates return false when the board is complete.
